summary: The connector has no idempotency key or existence check: repeating an insertText, insertTableRow, SUGGEST-mode insert, create_file or copy_file creates a duplicate every time. Two things protect against duplicates by accident or by choice: addDocumentTab rejects a repeated title, which rejects the whole batch atomically, and a requiredRevisionId guard turns the repeat into a clear 'does not match the latest revision' refusal. Errors are only 'refused' (INVALID_ARGUMENT with a message); nothing reports 'outcome unknown', and update_doc's reply omits the new revisionId, so a caller cannot check whether a lost write landed without re-reading.
